description: 奥德胡姆拉逐日舔开咸冰，使布里完整显现。
fullDescription: 奥德胡姆拉舔食带盐的冰块，第一日显出头发，第二日显出头，第三日布里完整显现。神族祖先因此不是从天而降，而是逐步从同一片原初物质中出现，并最终连到奥丁、威利与维的谱系。

MythCanvas locked continuity design: audumbla: Colossal shaggy pale primeval cow, visibly larger and more ancient than ordinary cattle.；audumbla: Use the same wide sweeping horn silhouette, heavy forehead, dark nose, long winter coat, and monumental shoulder mass.；audumbla: Never substitute a smooth modern dairy cow or reduce her to ordinary livestock scale.；audumbla: Four milk streams must read as four clean mythic rivulets without anatomical grotesqueness.；buri: Handsome, powerful early-god adult in his apparent thirties, not an elderly patriarch.；buri: Pale wheat-blond shoulder-length hair, short neat beard, strong straight nose, clear gray-blue eyes, broad shoulders, and natural warm human skin.；buri: Simple frost-wet pale drapery only; no crown, armor, runes, weapon, or giant traits.；buri: Card 1003010003 is the face, age, hair, beard, and body-proportion reference.

Series-wide visual grammar: keep matte painterly surfaces；broad readable forms；limited focal sharpness；quiet atmospheric negative space；restrained blue-white frost and ember light；subject detail clearly stronger than background detail; avoid glossy game-CG rendering；hyper-detailed-everything；generic Viking cosplay；floating realm platforms；science-fiction orbit graphics；random glowing runes；multiple competing focal centers.
